lines.text: The old mirror can throw a lantern beam across the valley. But one flash means danger, not home.
I found three marks on the brass dial. Is that the home signal, or am I reading the chart upside down?
Three flashes, then a pause. My sister taught me that from the ridge. She'll know we're alive.
You read it right, Pim. Turn the mirror west. There—three lights answered from the valley. We have a way home.
